course.title: Flutter — Complete Deep Mobile Development Course
course.description: A Flutter-specific, beginner-to-advanced mobile development course with detailed UI, state, networking, persistence, authentication, testing, performance and production release lessons.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the platform properly; no fixed cross-mobile template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Test, optimize and prepare production releases.
Build a complete learning-platform mobile client.

modules.title: Flutter Foundations
modules.description: Flutter SDK, project structure, Dart entry point, widgets and rendering model.

lessons.title: Flutter Foundations
lessons.description: Flutter SDK, project structure, Dart entry point, widgets and rendering model.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a real mobile learning workflow.
Handle state, lifecycle and errors correctly.

notes.text: Flutter SDK, project structure, Dart entry point, widgets and rendering model.
Learn flutter foundations by understanding the mobile-app problem first, then the framework concept, then a small implementation, and finally how it fits into a production learning application.

Flutter Foundations is important when building a reliable mobile learning experience. Students should understand not only how to make the screen work, but also state, lifecycle, networking, performance, accessibility and production behavior.

notes.caption: Add a mobile architecture or UI diagram showing Flutter Foundations visually.

items: Handle loading, empty and error states.

notes.code:
Scenario: Create and run the first learning-platform app.

Flow: user action -> UI state -> application logic -> data source -> result -> updated UI.

items: Define the state and data boundary.
Test loading, success and failure states.
Test different screen sizes and accessibility.
Putting all state into one component.
Blocking the UI with synchronous work.
Building only for one screen size.
Keep UI and data responsibilities separated.
I can explain Flutter Foundations in my own words.
I can implement a small example.
I can explain the data/state flow.
I can handle a failure state.
I can explain one production concern.
